review.protocol: DNeasy tissue DNA extraction (nPOD SOP-79, section 1.0)
assumptions: 8 samples are processed, one per row (A-H) of column 1.
The 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes with the tissue sit in positions A1-H1 of a 96-position rack, represented as the plate 'lysis_tubes' (1500 uL per position).
DNeasy Mini spin columns in 2 ml collection tubes sit in positions A1-H1 of a 96-position rack, represented as the plate 'spin_columns' (about 700 uL per column).

The whole mixture is taken as 600 uL (180 ATL + 20 proteinase K + 200 AL + 200 ethanol), moved in one 1000 uL tip aspiration. The operator moves any leftover liquid by hand when the rack comes off the deck.
Proteinase K is loaded into a small trough so that all 8 channels can draw at once. 1000 uL is loaded to cover the trough's dead volume.
Filter tips are used throughout, as the SOP lists filter pipette tips.
Fresh tips are used for every addition. Tips are dropped before every manual step.
The labware is taken off the deck for each vortex, incubation and centrifuge step and put back in the same position.
The incubation duration_min is an estimate (2 h, plus up to 2 more if digestion is incomplete).

suggestions.detail: 840 uL would be left over. About 200 uL covers the plan with 20% to spare; a container's own dead volume comes on top of that.
suggestions.request: Load 200 uL in 'proteinase_k' instead of 1000 uL, if the container's dead volume allows.

suggestions.title: 'te_buffer' starts 3.7 mm deep and ends 1.8 mm deep
suggestions.detail: 1200 uL spreads thin in this container. Below about 2 mm a tip draws air or misses the liquid; the simulator checks volume, not depth. Load more, or use a narrower container (a tube) for a small volume.

manual_steps.instruction: Place tissue in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube for each of the 8 samples. Use 12-15 mg spleen or 25 mg pancreas. Mince further with sterile scissors or scalpel to aid digestion. Put the open tubes in positions A1-H1 of the lysis tube rack on the deck.
Cap the tubes, mix thoroughly by vortexing, then return the open tubes to positions A1-H1 on the deck.

Incubate the capped tubes at 56°C in a hybridization oven with moderate rotation until tissue is completely lysed. Vortex well every 30 minutes. Check level of digestion at 2 hours; if digestion is incomplete, continue 1-2 more hours. Then return the tubes to positions A1-H1 on the deck.
Vortex the capped tubes 15 seconds, then return the open tubes to positions A1-H1 on the deck.
Cap the tubes and vortex thoroughly, then return the open tubes to positions A1-H1 on the deck.
Cap the tubes and vortex again, then return the open tubes to positions A1-H1 on the deck.
Place 8 DNeasy Mini spin columns, each in a 2 ml collection tube, in positions A1-H1 of the spin column rack on the deck, lids open.
Close the spin columns, centrifuge at ≥6000 x g for 1 minute. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and return them, lids open, to positions A1-H1 of the spin column rack on the deck.
Close the spin columns, centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥6000 x g. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy column in a new 2 ml collection tube and return them, lids open, to positions A1-H1 of the spin column rack on the deck.
Close the spin columns, centrifuge for 3 minutes at 20,000 x g to dry the DNeasy membrane. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and return them, lids open, to positions A1-H1 of the spin column rack on the deck.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Close the spin columns and centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥6000 x g to elute DNA. Keep the 1.5 ml tubes with the eluted DNA and discard the spin columns.
